mapper.select: select date_format(submit_day, '%Y-%m-%d') as submitDay, sum(check_pass_num) as passNum, sum(check_ng_num) as ngNum, sum(check_pass_num + check_ng_num) as totalNum from micro_work_submit where submit_type = '1' and submit_status = '0' and submit_day between #{startDate} and #{endDate} and tenant_code = #{tenantCode} group by submitDay having ifnull(sum(check_pass_num + check_ng_num), 0) > 0 order by submitDay asc

select ifnull(sum(pass_num), 0) as passNum, ifnull(sum(ng_num), 0) as ngNum, ifnull(sum(pass_num + ng_num), 0) as totalNum from micro_work_submit where submit_type = '1' and submit_day between #{startDate} and #{endDate} and tenant_code = #{tenantCode}

select date_format(submit_day, '%Y-%m-%d') as submitDay, sum(pass_num) as passNum, sum(ng_num) as ngNum, sum(pass_num + ng_num) as totalNum from micro_work_submit where submit_type = '1' and submit_day between #{startDate} and #{endDate} and tenant_code = #{tenantCode} group by submitDay having ifnull(sum(pass_num + ng_num), 0) > 0 order by submitDay asc

select ifnull(sum(pass_num), 0) as passNum, ifnull(sum(ng_num), 0) as ngNum, ifnull(sum(pass_num + ng_num), 0) as totalNum from micro_work_submit where submit_type = '1' and submit_status <> '0' and submit_day between #{startDate} and #{endDate} and tenant_code = #{tenantCode}

select mu.nick_name as nickName, mu.user_name as userName, ifnull(sum(m.pass_num + m.ng_num), 0) as submitNum from micro_work_submit m left join micro_user mu on mu.id = m.submit_user and mu.tenant_code = m.tenant_code where m.submit_type = '1' and m.submit_day between #{startDate} and #{endDate} and m.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} group by m.submit_user order by submitNum desc limit 10

select mpc.process_name as processName, mpc.process_code as processCode, sum(mws.check_pass_num) as checkPassNum, sum(mws.check_ng_num) as checkNgNum, truncate(sum(mws.check_pass_num) / nullif(sum(mws.check_pass_num + mws.check_ng_num), 0), 3) as passRate from micro_work_submit mws left join micro_process_common mpc on mws.operate_process_seq = mpc.process_seq and mws.tenant_code = mpc.tenant_code left join micro_product mp on mws.product_seq = mp.product_seq and mp.tenant_code = mws.tenant_code left join micro_user mu on mu.id = mws.submit_user and mu.tenant_code = mws.tenant_code where mws.submit_type = '1' and mws.submit_status = '0' and mws.submit_day between #{startDate} and #{endDate} and mws.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} and (#{processNameOrCode} is null or #{processNameOrCode} = '' or mpc.process_name = #{processNameOrCode} or mpc.process_code = #{processNameOrCode}) and (#{productNameOrCode} is null or #{productNameOrCode} = '' or mp.product_name = #{productNameOrCode} or mp.product_code = #{productNameOrCode}) and (#{employeeName} is null or #{employeeName} = '' or mu.nick_name = #{employeeName} or mu.user_name = #{employeeName}) group by mws.operate_process_seq having ifnull(sum(mws.check_pass_num + mws.check_ng_num), 0) > 0 order by passRate asc

select mu.nick_name as nickName, mu.user_name as userName, sum(mws.check_pass_num) as checkPassNum, sum(mws.check_ng_num) as checkNgNum, truncate(sum(mws.check_pass_num) / nullif(sum(mws.check_pass_num + mws.check_ng_num), 0), 3) as passRate from micro_work_submit mws left join micro_user mu on mu.id = mws.submit_user and mu.tenant_code = mws.tenant_code left join micro_product mp on mws.product_seq = mp.product_seq and mp.tenant_code = mws.tenant_code left join micro_process_common mpc on mws.operate_process_seq = mpc.process_seq and mws.tenant_code = mpc.tenant_code where mws.submit_type = '1' and mws.submit_status = '0' and mws.submit_day between #{startDate} and #{endDate} and mws.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} and (#{employeeName} is null or #{employeeName} = '' or mu.nick_name = #{employeeName} or mu.user_name = #{employeeName}) and (#{productNameOrCode} is null or #{productNameOrCode} = '' or mp.product_name = #{productNameOrCode} or mp.product_code = #{productNameOrCode}) and (#{processNameOrCode} is null or #{processNameOrCode} = '' or mpc.process_name = #{processNameOrCode} or mpc.process_code = #{processNameOrCode}) group by mws.submit_user having ifnull(sum(mws.check_pass_num + mws.check_ng_num), 0) > 0 order by passRate asc

select mp.product_name as productName, mp.product_code as productCode, sum(mws.check_pass_num) as checkPassNum, sum(mws.check_ng_num) as checkNgNum, truncate(sum(mws.check_pass_num) / nullif(sum(mws.check_pass_num + mws.check_ng_num), 0), 3) as passRate from micro_work_submit mws left join micro_product mp on mws.product_seq = mp.product_seq and mp.tenant_code = mws.tenant_code left join micro_process_common mpc on mws.operate_process_seq = mpc.process_seq and mws.tenant_code = mpc.tenant_code left join micro_user mu on mu.id = mws.submit_user and mu.tenant_code = mws.tenant_code where mws.submit_type = '1' and mws.submit_status = '0' and mws.submit_day between #{startDate} and #{endDate} and mws.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} and (#{productNameOrCode} is null or #{productNameOrCode} = '' or mp.product_name = #{productNameOrCode} or mp.product_code = #{productNameOrCode}) and (#{processNameOrCode} is null or #{processNameOrCode} = '' or mpc.process_name = #{processNameOrCode} or mpc.process_code = #{processNameOrCode}) and (#{employeeName} is null or #{employeeName} = '' or mu.nick_name = #{employeeName} or mu.user_name = #{employeeName}) group by mws.product_seq having ifnull(sum(mws.check_pass_num + mws.check_ng_num), 0) > 0 order by passRate asc
select date_format(max(submit_day), '%Y-%m-%d') from micro_work_submit where submit_type = '1' and submit_status = '0' and tenant_code = #{tenantCode} and submit_day <= curdate()
select ifnull(sum(num), 0) as finishedNum, count(*) as productCnt from micro_finished_product_storage where tenant_code = #{tenantCode} and num > 0

select product_name as productName, product_seq as productSeq, ifnull(sum(num), 0) as finishedNum from micro_finished_product_storage where tenant_code = #{tenantCode} and num > 0 group by product_seq, tenant_code, product_name order by finishedNum desc limit 10

select ifnull(sum(check_pass_num + check_ng_num) / 30, 0) from micro_work_submit where submit_type = '1' and submit_status = '0' and submit_day >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 29 day) and tenant_code = #{tenantCode}

select o.order_no as orderNo, mp.product_name as productName, mp.product_code as productCode, o.plan_num as planNum, o.finish_num as finishNum, round(o.plan_num - o.finish_num, 0) as remainingNum, date_format(o.delivery_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as deliveryDate, ifnull(round((o.plan_num - o.finish_num) / nullif(#{dailyCap}, 0) * 1.2, 0), 0) as needDays, date_add(curdate(), interval ifnull(round((o.plan_num - o.finish_num) / nullif(#{dailyCap}, 0) * 1.2, 0), 0) day) as predictDate, datediff(date_add(curdate(), interval ifnull(round((o.plan_num - o.finish_num) / nullif(#{dailyCap}, 0) * 1.2, 0), 0) day), date_format(o.delivery_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) as riskDays from micro_manufacture_order o left join micro_product mp on o.product_seq = mp.product_seq and mp.tenant_code = o.tenant_code where o.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} and o.order_status in ('10', '20', '30') and o.plan_num > o.finish_num and datediff(date_add(curdate(), interval ifnull(round((o.plan_num - o.finish_num) / nullif(#{dailyCap}, 0) * 1.2, 0), 0) day), date_format(o.delivery_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) > 0 order by o.delivery_date asc limit 10

select o.order_no as orderNo, mp.product_name as productName, mp.product_code as productCode, o.plan_num as planNum, o.finish_num as finishNum, round(o.plan_num - o.finish_num, 0) as remainingNum, date_format(o.delivery_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as deliveryDate, date_add(curdate(), interval ifnull(round((o.plan_num - o.finish_num) / nullif(#{dailyCap}, 0) * 1.2, 0), 0) day) as predictDate from micro_manufacture_order o left join micro_product mp on o.product_seq = mp.product_seq and mp.tenant_code = o.tenant_code where o.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} and o.order_status in ('10', '20', '30') and o.plan_num > o.finish_num and datediff(date_add(curdate(), interval ifnull(round((o.plan_num - o.finish_num) / nullif(#{dailyCap}, 0) * 1.2, 0), 0) day), date_format(o.delivery_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) <= 0 and datediff(date_format(o.delivery_date, '%Y-%m-%d'), curdate()) <= 7 order by o.delivery_date asc limit 10

select (case #{dim} when 'process' then mpc.process_name when 'product' then mp.product_name when 'employee' then mu.nick_name when 'day' then date_format(mws.submit_day, '%Y-%m-%d') else '全部' end) as groupName, (case #{dim} when 'process' then mws.operate_process_seq when 'product' then mws.product_seq when 'employee' then mws.submit_user when 'day' then date_format(mws.submit_day, '%Y-%m-%d') else 'all' end) as groupKey, sum(mws.check_pass_num) as passNum, sum(mws.check_ng_num) as ngNum, sum(mws.check_pass_num + mws.check_ng_num) as totalNum, count(*) as rowCnt from micro_work_submit mws left join micro_process_common mpc on mws.operate_process_seq = mpc.process_seq and mws.tenant_code = mpc.tenant_code left join micro_product mp on mws.product_seq = mp.product_seq and mws.tenant_code = mp.tenant_code left join micro_user mu on mu.id = mws.submit_user and mu.tenant_code = mws.tenant_code where mws.submit_type = '1' and mws.submit_status = '0' and mws.submit_day between #{startDate} and #{endDate} and mws.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} and (#{productNameOrCode} is null or #{productNameOrCode} = '' or mp.product_name = #{productNameOrCode} or mp.product_code = #{productNameOrCode}) and (#{processNameOrCode} is null or #{processNameOrCode} = '' or mpc.process_name = #{processNameOrCode} or mpc.process_code = #{processNameOrCode}) and (#{employeeName} is null or #{employeeName} = '' or mu.nick_name = #{employeeName} or mu.user_name = #{employeeName}) group by groupName, groupKey order by groupKey

select ifnull(nullif(q.ng_type, ''), '未分类') as groupName, ifnull(nullif(q.ng_type, ''), 'UNKNOWN') as groupKey, sum(q.ng_num) as ngNum, sum(q.pass_num) as passNum, sum(q.pass_num + q.ng_num) as totalNum, count(*) as rowCnt from micro_quality_control_record q left join micro_product mp on q.product_seq = mp.product_seq and q.tenant_code = mp.tenant_code left join micro_process_common mpc on q.process_seq = mpc.process_seq and q.tenant_code = mpc.tenant_code where q.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} and ifnull(q.active_flag, '1') = '1' and q.submit_date between #{startDate} and #{endDate} and (#{productNameOrCode} is null or #{productNameOrCode} = '' or mp.product_name = #{productNameOrCode} or mp.product_code = #{productNameOrCode}) and (#{processNameOrCode} is null or #{processNameOrCode} = '' or mpc.process_name = #{processNameOrCode} or mpc.process_code = #{processNameOrCode}) group by groupName, groupKey order by ngNum desc

select mp.product_name as productName, mp.product_code as productCode, ifnull(sum(mps.pass_num), 0) as wipNum from micro_process_storage mps left join micro_product mp on mp.tenant_code = mps.tenant_code and mp.product_seq = mps.product_seq where mps.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} and mps.pass_num > 0 group by mps.product_seq, mp.product_name, mp.product_code order by wipNum desc limit 10

select mp.product_seq as nodeId, mp.product_code as code, mp.product_name as name, count(w.id) as submitCnt, ifnull(sum(w.check_pass_num), 0) as passNum, ifnull(sum(w.check_ng_num), 0) as ngNum, ifnull((select sum(f.num) from micro_finished_product_storage f where f.tenant_code = mp.tenant_code and f.product_seq = mp.product_seq and f.num > 0), 0) as finishedNum, ifnull((select sum(s.pass_num) from micro_process_storage s where s.tenant_code = mp.tenant_code and s.product_seq = mp.product_seq and s.pass_num > 0), 0) as wipNum from micro_product mp left join micro_work_submit w on w.tenant_code = mp.tenant_code and w.product_seq = mp.product_seq and w.submit_type = '1' and w.submit_status = '0' and w.submit_day >= #{startDate} where mp.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} group by mp.product_seq, mp.product_code, mp.product_name, mp.tenant_code order by submitCnt desc, mp.product_seq

select mpc.process_seq as nodeId, mpc.process_code as code, mpc.process_name as name, count(w.id) as submitCnt, count(distinct w.product_seq) as productCnt, ifnull(sum(w.check_pass_num), 0) as passNum, ifnull(sum(w.check_ng_num), 0) as ngNum from micro_process_common mpc left join micro_work_submit w on w.tenant_code = mpc.tenant_code and w.operate_process_seq = mpc.process_seq and w.submit_type = '1' and w.submit_status = '0' and w.submit_day >= #{startDate} where mpc.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} group by mpc.process_seq, mpc.process_code, mpc.process_name, mpc.tenant_code order by submitCnt desc

select mu.id as nodeId, mu.nick_name as name, mu.user_name as account, count(w.id) as submitCnt, count(distinct w.product_seq) as productCnt, count(distinct w.operate_process_seq) as processCnt, ifnull(sum(w.check_pass_num), 0) as passNum, ifnull(sum(w.check_ng_num), 0) as ngNum from micro_user mu left join micro_work_submit w on w.tenant_code = mu.tenant_code and w.submit_user = mu.id and w.submit_type = '1' and w.submit_status = '0' and w.submit_day >= #{startDate} where mu.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} group by mu.id, mu.nick_name, mu.user_name, mu.tenant_code order by submitCnt desc limit 50

select w.product_seq as productSeq, w.operate_process_seq as processSeq, count(w.id) as submitCnt, date_format(min(w.submit_day), '%Y-%m-%d') as firstDay, ifnull(sum(w.check_pass_num), 0) as passNum, ifnull(sum(w.check_ng_num), 0) as ngNum from micro_work_submit w where w.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} and w.submit_type = '1' and w.submit_status = '0' and w.submit_day >= #{startDate} group by w.product_seq, w.operate_process_seq order by submitCnt desc

select w.submit_user as employeeId, w.operate_process_seq as processSeq, count(w.id) as submitCnt, ifnull(sum(w.check_pass_num), 0) as passNum, ifnull(sum(w.check_ng_num), 0) as ngNum from micro_work_submit w where w.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} and w.submit_type = '1' and w.submit_status = '0' and w.submit_day >= #{startDate} group by w.submit_user, w.operate_process_seq order by submitCnt desc

select (select count(*) from micro_product p where p.tenant_code = #{tenantCode}) as productDict, (select count(*) from micro_process_common c where c.tenant_code = #{tenantCode}) as processDict, (select count(*) from micro_user u where u.tenant_code = #{tenantCode}) as employeeDict, (select count(distinct w.submit_user) from micro_work_submit w where w.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} and w.submit_type = '1' and w.submit_status = '0') as employeeUsed, (select count(*) from micro_quality_control_record q where q.tenant_code = #{tenantCode}) as qcCnt, (select count(*) from micro_complete_report r where r.tenant_code = #{tenantCode}) as completeCnt, (select ifnull(sum(s.pass_num), 0) from micro_process_storage s where s.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} and s.pass_num > 0) as wipNum, (select ifnull(sum(f.num), 0) from micro_finished_product_storage f where f.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} and f.num > 0) as finishedNum

select table_name as tableName, column_name as columnName, column_type as columnType, column_comment as columnComment from information_schema.columns where table_schema = database() and table_name in #{t} order by table_name, ordinal_position
${sql}
mapper.insert: insert into micro_ai_sql_audit (tenant_code, session_id, message_id, user_id, question, question_hash, intent, purpose, sql_text, sql_final, guard_ok, reject_reason, tables_json, columns_json, tenant_injected, limit_rewritten, retry_count, exec_status, exec_error, row_count, elapsed_ms, model, created_by, created_date) values (#{tenantCode}, #{sessionId}, #{messageId}, #{userId}, #{question}, #{questionHash}, #{intent}, #{purpose}, #{sqlText}, #{sqlFinal}, #{guardOk}, #{rejectReason}, #{tablesJson}, #{columnsJson}, #{tenantInjected}, #{limitRewritten}, #{retryCount}, #{execStatus}, #{execError}, #{rowCount}, #{elapsedMs}, #{model}, #{createdBy}, now())
